_comment: Hand edits for ranks 5001-10000 of the Portuguese deck (tools/extend_deck_portuguese.py). Keys are lemmas. {"drop": true} removes a lemma from the extension; {"gloss": "...", "pos": "...", "posName": "..."} replace what the pipeline produced (and bypass the automatic filters for that lemma); {"sentences": [{"text": "...", "translation": "..."}]} adds sentences written for the app (marked original). Only ranks 5001+ are affected; the first 5,000 cards are never touched. Drops are mostly lookalike lemmas that spaCy credits with another word's frequency, proper-name-like or foreign words, and glosses that are not the main sense.
